meetAishwarya.title: Meet Aishwarya
bioParagraphs: With 5+ years of experience, Aishwarya has helped women with thyroid, PCOS and many hormonal issues understand what their body has been trying to tell them.

She does not believe in crash diets or one-size-fits-all charts. She looks at your reports, your gut, your stress and your daily routine, then builds a plan that fits your life and your kitchen help you progress.
meetAishwarya.mission: My mission To help every woman with thyroid feel energetic, confident and in control of her health again.

items.question: Do I have to stop my medicine?
items.answer: No. Any change in medication is decided only with your doctor.

items.question: How soon will I see results?
items.answer: Most women notice better energy in 3 to 6 weeks. Results vary from person to person.

items.question: Is the consultation really free?
items.answer: Yes. Your first consultation is free, with no obligation.
